verdict.rationale: Wise documents a broad API surface covering much of what a UI user would do: multi-currency balances, conversions and single or batch transfers, card issuance and spend controls, sensitive card data, statements in many formats, disputes, support cases, contacts, delivery estimates and webhook management. However, there is no documented claim of full UI/API parity, and some functions (disputes, Embedded Flows) rely on Wise-hosted Dynamic Flow or iframe UIs rather than pure API calls. Missing for 10: an explicit API-UI parity statement, pure-API coverage of flows currently delivered via hosted UI, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
